definitions.gloss: campaign promise, public pledge, manifesto commitment
definitions.explanation: A promise or commitment made publicly, especially by a politician or political party during an election campaign. Can also refer to any formal pledge made to the public.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧{公約|こうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掲|かか}げる→掲げる：12791_kakageru⟧。
{公約|こうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}れなかった→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The politician who could not keep his campaign promises was criticized.

examples.japanese: ⟦{減税|げんぜい}→減税：13318_genzei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{公約|こうやく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掲|かか}げて→掲げる：12791_kakageru⟧⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{実現|じつげん}→実現：03276_jitsugen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{至|いた}らなかった→至る：02009_itaru⟧。
examples.english: He was elected on a pledge to cut taxes, but it was never realized.

notes:
Primarily used in political contexts. Often discussed in terms of whether promises are kept or broken.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公約|こうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掲|かか}げる→掲げる：12791_kakageru⟧ (put forward a pledge)
- {公約|こうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧ (keep a promise)
- {公約|こうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}る→破る：02321_yaburu⟧ (break a promise)
- {公約|こうやく}⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧ (violation of a pledge)
- ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧{公約|こうやく} (election promise)
- マニフェスト (manifesto — near-synonym borrowed from English)

In Japanese politics, {公約|こうやく} is the traditional term. The loanword マニフェスト gained popularity in the 2000s to emphasize more specific, measurable commitments.
